items.title: Pope Leo discharged from hospital after lung cancer surgery
items.brief: Pope Leo XIV left hospital Saturday, four days after undergoing lung cancer surgery in a swift return to his duties following the first health scare of his papacy.

items.title: Trump administration seeks to remove judge in golf course case, accusing her of ‘egregious’ behavior
items.brief: The Trump administration has requested the removal of the federal judge overseeing a legal challenge to President Donald Trump’s plans to overhaul a Washington, DC public golf course, accusing her of having “bias.”

items.title: Trump waives Russia-related sanctions before they even kick in as Ukraine ties worsen
items.brief: US President Donald Trump has waived a further slate of sanctions related to Russian fossil fuel sales, days before they were to take effect under a bill he signed into law last month.

items.title: Rep. Ilhan Omar challenges legality of Trump administration search of her home
